datasets.name: gl_month
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(`Posting Year` AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company, `Posting Month` AS month,
 `Account Type` AS account_type,
 MEASURE(`Net Movement (Local)`) AS net_movement, MEASURE(`Debit (Local)`) AS debit,
 MEASURE(`Credit (Local)`) AS credit, MEASURE(`Journal Line Count`) AS line_count,
 MEASURE(`Reversal Line Count`) AS reversal_lines, MEASURE(`Accounting Document Count`) AS doc_count,
 MEASURE(`YTD Net Movement (Local)`) AS ytd_net
 FROM semantic_gl_journal_metrics WHERE `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4

datasets.name: gl_account
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(`Posting Year` AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company, `G/L Account` AS gl_account,
 `Account Type` AS account_type, MEASURE(`Net Movement (Local)`) AS net_movement,
 MEASURE(`Debit (Local)`) AS debit, MEASURE(`Credit (Local)`) AS credit
 FROM semantic_gl_journal_metrics WHERE `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4

datasets.name: gl_lag
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(`Posting Year` AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company, `Posting Month` AS month,
 MEASURE(`Average Entry Lag Days`) AS avg_entry_lag
 FROM semantic_gl_journal_metrics WHERE `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3

datasets.name: gl_debit_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(`Posting Year` AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company,
 MEASURE(`Debit (Local)`) AS debit FROM semantic_gl_journal_metrics WHERE `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2

datasets.name: cf_month
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(year(`Posting Date`) AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company, `Flow Month` AS month,
 `Scenario` AS scenario, MEASURE(`Net Cash Flow (Local)`) AS net_cash,
 MEASURE(`Cash Inflow (Local)`) AS cash_in, MEASURE(`Cash Outflow (Local)`) AS cash_out,
 MEASURE(`Flow Count`) AS flow_count
 FROM semantic_cash_flow_metrics WHERE `Flow Month` >= DATE'2022-01-01' AND `Flow Month` <= DATE'2026-12-31' AND `Posting Date` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3,4

datasets.name: cf_ytd_actual
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(year(`Posting Date`) AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company, `Flow Month` AS month,
 MEASURE(`YTD Net Cash Flow (Local)`) AS ytd_cash
 FROM semantic_cash_flow_metrics WHERE `Scenario`='actual' AND `Flow Month` >= DATE'2022-01-01' AND `Flow Month` <= DATE'2026-12-31' AND `Posting Date` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3

datasets.name: cf_accuracy
queryLines:
SELECT fiscal_year, month, actual, forecast, variance, variance_pct, accuracy_pct / 100 AS accuracy_frac FROM (
 SELECT CAST(year(`Posting Date`) AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Flow Month` AS month,
  MEASURE(`Actual Net Cash Flow`) AS actual, MEASURE(`Forecast Net Cash Flow`) AS forecast,
  MEASURE(`Forecast Variance`) AS variance, MEASURE(`Forecast Variance %`) AS variance_pct,
  MEASURE(`Forecast Accuracy %`) AS accuracy_pct
 FROM semantic_cash_flow_metrics WHERE `Flow Month` >= DATE'2022-01-01' AND `Flow Month` <= DATE'2026-12-31' AND `Posting Date` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2)
 WHERE actual IS NOT NULL AND actual <> 0

datasets.name: cf_actual_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(year(`Posting Date`) AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company,
 MEASURE(`Net Cash Flow (Local)`) AS net_cash
 FROM semantic_cash_flow_metrics WHERE `Scenario`='actual' AND `Flow Month` >= DATE'2022-01-01' AND `Flow Month` <= DATE'2026-12-31' AND `Posting Date` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2

datasets.name: cc_hier
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(`Posting Year` AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company,
 `Hierarchy Level 1` AS hier_l1, `Hierarchy Level 2` AS hier_l2,
 MEASURE(`Actual Spend (Local)`) AS spend, MEASURE(`Line Count`) AS line_count
 FROM semantic_cost_center_metrics WHERE `Hierarchy Level 1` IS NOT NULL AND `Posting Month` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4

datasets.name: cc_top
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(`Posting Year` AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company, `Cost Center` AS cost_center,
 `Cost Center Name` AS cost_center_name, `Department` AS department,
 MEASURE(`Actual Spend (Local)`) AS spend
 FROM semantic_cost_center_metrics WHERE `Posting Month` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5

datasets.name: cc_ytd
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(`Posting Year` AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company, `Posting Month` AS month,
 MEASURE(`YTD Spend (Local)`) AS ytd_spend, MEASURE(`Actual Spend (Local)`) AS spend
 FROM semantic_cost_center_metrics WHERE `Posting Month` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3

datasets.name: oi_aging
queryLines:
SELECT fiscal_year, company, ar_ap, aging_bucket,
 ABS(open_amount) AS open_amount, ABS(overdue_amount) AS overdue_amount, open_items FROM (
 SELECT CAST(year(`Posting Date`) AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company, `AR / AP` AS ar_ap,
  `Aging Bucket` AS aging_bucket, MEASURE(`Open Amount`) AS open_amount,
  MEASURE(`Overdue Amount`) AS overdue_amount, MEASURE(`Open Item Count`) AS open_items
 FROM semantic_open_items_ar_ap_metrics WHERE `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4)

datasets.name: oi_party
queryLines:
SELECT fiscal_year, company, ar_ap, party, ABS(open_amount) AS open_amount FROM (
 SELECT CAST(year(`Posting Date`) AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company, `AR / AP` AS ar_ap,
  COALESCE(`Supplier`, `Customer`) AS party, MEASURE(`Open Amount`) AS open_amount
 FROM semantic_open_items_ar_ap_metrics WHERE `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4)

datasets.name: oi_dsodpo
queryLines:
SELECT `AR / AP` AS ar_ap, MEASURE(`DSO / DPO (Amount-Weighted)`) AS avg_days
 FROM semantic_open_items_ar_ap_metrics WHERE `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1

datasets.name: kpi_dso
queryLines:
SELECT MEASURE(`DSO / DPO (Amount-Weighted)`) AS dso
 FROM semantic_open_items_ar_ap_metrics WHERE `AR / AP`='AR' AND `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01'

datasets.name: kpi_dpo
queryLines:
SELECT MEASURE(`DSO / DPO (Amount-Weighted)`) AS dpo
 FROM semantic_open_items_ar_ap_metrics WHERE `AR / AP`='AP' AND `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01'

datasets.name: kpi_open_ar
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(year(`Posting Date`) AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company,
 MEASURE(`Open Amount`) AS open_amount FROM semantic_open_items_ar_ap_metrics WHERE `AR / AP`='AR' AND `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2

datasets.name: kpi_open_ap
queryLines:
SELECT fiscal_year, company, ABS(open_amount) AS open_amount FROM (
 SELECT CAST(year(`Posting Date`) AS INT) AS fiscal_year, `Company` AS company,
  MEASURE(`Open Amount`) AS open_amount FROM semantic_open_items_ar_ap_metrics WHERE `AR / AP`='AP' AND `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2)

datasets.name: gauge_clear
queryLines: SELECT MEASURE(`Cleared Item Count`) AS cleared, MEASURE(`Item Count`) AS total FROM semantic_open_items_ar_ap_metrics WHERE `Posting Date` >= DATE'2022-01-01'
